SITE_URL.description: Your docs site's URL with its base path, such as `https://acme.github.io/docs`. The Worker reads the index at `SITE_URL/ask-index.json`, which the [ondocs plugins](https://ondocs.vercel.app/docs) write with every build.

CHAT_MODEL.description: The Workers AI model that writes the answers. The [Workers AI guide](https://ondocs.vercel.app/docs/workers-ai) compares them by cost.

AI.description: Workers AI embeds the questions and writes the answers: no API key.
